annotation_policy.unit: Outer physical silhouette. Coins, discs and bottle caps are circular target objects; cassettes, their cases, near-rectangular floppy disks/SD adapters are rectangles, including mildly chamfered corners. Perspective and occlusion are explicitly stress cases.
annotation_policy.exclude: Internal slots, printed text, holes, labels, shadows and small texture regions are not separate target objects.
annotation_policy.coordinates: xywh, half-open, in distributed image pixels. Images have maximum side 800.
annotation_policy.annotation_quality: Manual outer-object boxes checked visually before predictions; no second annotator or pixel masks. Occluded boxes are estimates within the image; clipped boxes cover the visible extent. Physical circular objects can appear elliptical under perspective; report these as stress, not ideal 2D circles.

audit.statistical_scope: Small convenience sample, manual single-annotator boxes; not a representative real-world benchmark.

Old six photos are development data, not an independent phase-3 test.
Manual single-annotator boxes; occluded boxes estimated, clipped boxes cover visible extent.
Perspective of a circular physical object may look elliptical and is categorized as stress.
No automatic split of touching objects. All failures are retained.
